Class MervClient

java.lang.Object
org.teche.merv.client.MervClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class MervClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Main client class for interacting with the MERV Test Management System API

    • finishTestCase

      public TestCaseStatus finishTestCase(UUID testCaseId) throws MervClientException
      Finish a test case by calculating its status based on all test steps. The status is calculated according to the following rules: 1. If any step is IN_PROGRESS → status = INPROGRESS 2. If no IN_PROGRESS and any FAILED → status = FAILED 3. If no IN_PROGRESS and no PASSED, only SKIPPED → status = SKIPPED 4. Otherwise → status = PASSED
      Parameters:
      testCaseId - The test case ID
      Returns:
      The calculated test case status
      Throws:
      MervClientException - if the request fails

    • restartTestCase

      public TestCaseResponse restartTestCase(UUID testCaseId) throws MervClientException
      Restart a test case by resetting its status back to INPROGRESS. This allows test step status updates after a test case has been finished. After restarting, you can update test steps and then finish the test case again.
      Parameters:
      testCaseId - The test case ID
      Returns:
      The updated test case response with INPROGRESS status
      Throws:
      MervClientException - if the request fails
